usedFor: Android Texter keeps contacts with “Create or Update Contact” and sends texts through your Android Texter account with “Send SMS”.

bestTemplate.name: “Send Broadcast” in Android Texter
bestTemplate.why: It sends one personalized text to a long list of phone numbers through your Android Texter account.

watchOut: “Send SMS” can run now or at a scheduled time, and each send waits for your approval first.
